toggleLabel: Show the Sprint+ Websprinter read-aloud software

tutorial.title: Sprint+ Websprinter
tutorial.content:
The Sprint+ Websprinter is a read-aloud software that can read the content of web pages.
You can enable or disable the Websprinter via the accessibility settings on the left or via the keyboard shortcut ALT+S.

package.title: Adds Sprint+ accessibility toggle
package.description: Adds a toggle switch to the user's accessibility settings for enabling/disabling the Sprint+ Websprinter UI.
